reports.boundary: First installation of a factory-assembled four-legged park bench by mechanical sleeve anchoring on an accepted compatible existing reinforced-concrete host. No bench fabrication, new host construction, cantilever/epoxy route, unanchored placement or later maintenance.
reports.reference: 1 Item(s) of a complete qualified installed bench, with actual model, finish, arms, support, anchor and host qualifications; not one anchor or an assumed equivalent bench.
reports.primary_sources_review: UN CPC 3.0 p.290 expressly includes benches. Root visually read the scanned Landscape Forms Austin installation guide, dated 10/2009, including the freestanding mechanical route; supplier hardware is not included. Compressed-air hole clearing and actual anchor-maker instructions are retained. The current product page corroborates the product state. Historic illustrated numbers are not universal project thresholds.
reports.actual_route_gate: Accepted compatible concrete and fixing design; protected placement, glides removed where required, actual leveling, drilling/air clearing, mechanical fixing, inspection and closed corrections, signed complete-bench handover.
reports.mapping_review: Reviewed semantic subset lies inside the CPC leaf; narrower is accepted, without claiming all leaf routes or active/publication readiness. Independent reuse screening found no equivalent existing material methodology.
repairs_verified: Gross hardware/shim receipts/issues are reconciled with actual custody returns and retained stock; no double subtraction.
Supplier-included packaging is tracked physically without a second upstream burden.
Bench returns mean rejected-at-installation or surplus benches actually accepted back by a receiver, not supplier refusal to receive a return.
Minor finish repair is distinguished from substantial refinishing; material/finish repair changes trigger review.
Chinese source used_for header now parses; root current hashes supersede the historical author freeze.

reports.boundary: First erection of an actual complete factory metal-plate-connected timber roof-truss set on accepted bearings. No site cutting/notching/drilling or structural repair of trusses, factory manufacture, stick/steel/floor framing, host construction, roof covering or whole-roof diaphragm claim.
reports.reference: 1 Item(s) of the complete qualified braced erection-stage set, not one individual truss, area, full roof or equivalent generic timber quantity.
reports.primary_sources_review: UN CPC 3.0 p.291 expressly includes roof truss framing. Root independently read SBCA 2023 installation-process guidance and current BCSI/jobsite-package pages identifying the 2025 edition. No claim was made to read the paid full 2025 guide. Actual engineer/manufacturer package, placement and bracing instructions remain required foreground evidence.
reports.actual_route_gate: Actual package/approved lift and bracing plan, accepted stable bearings, inspected trusses, placement/anchorage, all required permanent member restraints/bracing and retained temporary stability, closed placement/fixing corrections and qualified signed stage transfer.
reports.mapping_review: Reviewed semantic subset lies inside the CPC leaf; narrower is accepted, without claiming all leaf routes or active/publication readiness. Independent reuse screening found no equivalent existing material methodology.
repairs_verified: Temporary support obligations explicitly cover P1 erection, P2 retained support awaiting later stability work, and P3 authorized removal/return/end of use, with owner, assets, all consumers, capital/use/replacement/termination burdens and full-cycle reconciliation.
Gross brace/connector receipts/issues are reconciled with actual receiver exits and stock states, without net/output double counting.
Included transport packaging is not duplicated as a separate burden input.
Chinese process inclusion/role and source used_for headers now parse. Retained stock is a state rather than an outward exit.

modules.manual_review: All 16 obligations of assembly, multi-period, rework and shared infrastructure were manually compared with final prose and advisory output. Continued temporary support activates the phase attribution module. Shared asset obligations remain required despite advisory non-detection. One intended service plus usable/rejected returns does not establish coproduct production.

reports.lookup_review: Two initial and two justified refinements were independently read. Generic construction/formwork, prefab wooden buildings and wooden parts do not establish the finished roof truss or qualified erected complete set. No exact flow selected; variable inputs, providers, returns, waste and releases await actual identities.
